segments.source: AI can expand what people learn, create and achieve. Making that progress worthwhile also means asking who could be harmed, how a system might fail and what would help us keep control. At Saturdays.AI, learning to build goes hand in hand with learning to question.
segments.en: AI can expand what people learn, create and achieve. Making that progress worthwhile also means asking who could be harmed, how a system might fail and what would help us keep control. At Saturdays.AI, learning to build goes hand in hand with learning to question.
segments.es: La IA puede ampliar lo que somos capaces de aprender, crear y conseguir. Para que ese progreso merezca la pena, también debemos preguntarnos quién podría sufrir daños, cómo podría fallar un sistema y qué nos ayudaría a mantener el control. En Saturdays.AI, aprender a construir va de la mano de aprender a cuestionar.

segments.source: The Introduction to AI Safety course explores advanced AI risks, malicious use, loss of control, systemic risks, evaluations, alignment, oversight and mitigations. It connects these ideas with real cases and possible future scenarios.
segments.en: The Introduction to AI Safety course explores advanced AI risks, malicious use, loss of control, systemic risks, evaluations, alignment, oversight and mitigations. It connects these ideas with real cases and possible future scenarios.
segments.es: El curso Introducción a la Seguridad de la IA explora los riesgos de la IA avanzada, el uso malintencionado, la pérdida de control, los riesgos sistémicos, las evaluaciones, el alineamiento, la supervisión y las medidas para reducir riesgos. Conecta estas ideas con casos reales y posibles escenarios futuros.

segments.source: AI Safety asks how we can reduce harmful behaviour and unintended consequences, evaluate capabilities and limitations, and maintain meaningful human oversight.
segments.en: AI Safety asks how we can reduce harmful behaviour and unintended consequences, evaluate capabilities and limitations, and maintain meaningful human oversight.
segments.es: La Seguridad de la IA aborda cómo reducir los comportamientos perjudiciales y las consecuencias no deseadas, evaluar capacidades y limitaciones y mantener una supervisión humana efectiva.

editorialReview.scope: Complete new Spanish and English copy

segments.source: AI Security also considers deliberate attacks: attempts to manipulate a system, expose sensitive information or misuse its tools and permissions. Protecting an AI application involves its data, software and operating environment as well as the model.
segments.en: AI Security also considers deliberate attacks: attempts to manipulate a system, expose sensitive information or misuse its tools and permissions. Protecting an AI application involves its data, software and operating environment as well as the model.
segments.es: La Seguridad de la IA también contempla los ataques deliberados: intentos de manipular un sistema, exponer información sensible o utilizar sus herramientas y permisos de forma indebida. Proteger una aplicación de IA implica atender a sus datos, su software y el entorno en el que opera, además del modelo.

editorialReview.scope: Complete new Spanish and English copy

segments.source: The two perspectives overlap. A useful starting question is: what could go wrong in this particular use, who would be affected, and what evidence would show that a safeguard works?
segments.en: The two perspectives overlap. A useful starting question is: what could go wrong in this particular use, who would be affected, and what evidence would show that a safeguard works?
segments.es: Ambas perspectivas se complementan. Una buena pregunta para empezar es: ¿qué podría salir mal en este uso concreto, a quién afectaría y qué evidencia demostraría que una medida de protección funciona?

segments.en: Define what the system should do and the actions it should never take on its own.

segments.source: The NIST framework offers a structured way to consider risks throughout an AI system's lifecycle. OWASP's guidance introduces practical security risks and mitigations for generative AI applications. These are independent resources for further learning.
segments.en: The NIST framework offers a structured way to consider risks throughout an AI system's lifecycle. OWASP's guidance introduces practical security risks and mitigations for generative AI applications. These are independent resources for further learning.
segments.es: El marco del NIST ofrece una forma estructurada de abordar los riesgos durante todo el ciclo de vida de un sistema de IA. Las guías de OWASP presentan riesgos de seguridad y medidas para reducirlos en aplicaciones de IA generativa. Son recursos independientes para seguir aprendiendo.
